What makes Blueberry Futures different?
May 5, 2025

Blueberry Futures stands out through our deep industry roots, strategic partnerships, and long-term vision. We are part of the Blueberry family of brands with over 10 years of experience in the trading and brokerage industry, bringing proven expertise to the world of proprietary futures trading.

Above all, we’re committed to sustainability - not just in trading practices, but in the longevity of our funded trader relationships. We don’t reward reckless strategies; we reward consistency, discipline, and knowledge. That’s how we build traders for the long run.

Do you restrict any countries from taking part in Blueberry Futures?
Do you restrict any countries from taking part in Blueberry Futures?
July 9, 2026

Yes. To comply with international laws, financial regulations, and internal risk controls, Blueberry Futures restricts access from the following countries and regions:

Australia

Cuba

Iran

North Korea (DPRK)

Syria

Pakistan

Somalia

Russia

Belarus

Venezuela

Myanmar (Burma)

Sudan

Zimbabwe

Crimea, Donetsk (DNR), and Luhansk (LNR) regions of Ukraine

Zaporizhzhia and Kherson (Russia-occupied areas of Ukraine)

Traders from these jurisdictions are not permitted to sign up, purchase evaluations, or access funded accounts. Use of VPNs, VPSs, or any location-masking tools to bypass these restrictions is strictly prohibited and may result in account termination and forfeiture of any profits.

 

If you're unsure about your eligibility, please contact our support team before registering.

Can I share or transfer my account?
May 5, 2025

No, you cannot share or transfer your account with Blueberry Futures.

Each account is strictly personal and must only be used by the individual who registered for it. Account sharing, trading on behalf of others, or entering into third-party arrangements is strictly prohibited and will result in disqualification and forfeiture of any profits or payouts.

 

This rule helps ensure fair use of the platform, protects data integrity, and maintains a level playing field for all traders.

💔 How to Cancel Your Subscription
💔 How to Cancel Your Subscription

To stop your recurring billing with Blueberry Futures, follow these four simple steps in your dashboard.

November 24, 2025
Step-by-Step Cancellation Process

Log In to Your Account: Access your Blueberry Futures trader dashboard.

Navigate to 'Account': Find the 'Subscriptions' tab on the Superior menu.

Select 'Cancel Subscription': Click the option to manage your current plan details.

Confirm Cancellation: A final prompt will appear asking you to confirm your decision. Click 'Yes' to finalize the cancellation.

 

 

Important Considerations

Account Access: Your trading account remains active and accessible until the end of the current paid billing cycle.

Challenge Reset: Canceled Evaluation are immediately ineligible for any future resets, even if the cancellation is future-dated.

Payouts: Ensure all pending payouts have been processed before your access ends.

 

 

Note: If you are experiencing difficulties or would like to provide feedback, please contact our support team before canceling.
